announced buffer stock of 20 lakh tonne;

DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:

establish nuclear power station in the
State?

Andhra Pradesh during the said period and
what have been the achievements, district-

(d) what steps Government are con-

effective?

DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:

an official protest against the intimidation

Charge d'affairs was treated badly in

Pakistan High Commission's four officials

(e) the steps Government contem-

Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

to the tune of crores of rupees;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the VSNL has taken any
steps to control the situation; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

Bangladesh and China in Beijing;

balance of power in the Indian Sub-

Andhra Pradesh;
